title: x63 follow-up: defensive assert + zero-arc-rows coverage on closeOpenArcAndOpenNext
description:
Two non-blocking hardening items surfaced in the code review of loreweaver-x63.3 (commit c92c3f1):

1. packages/core/src/memory/campaignArc.ts:291 - the UPDATE that closes the arc does not assert info.changes === 1. Within the current transaction the open-arc verification at step 1 guarantees the row exists, so it can never silently no-op today. Add the assert as a defensive guard against future refactors that move the open-arc verification outside the transaction.

2. packages/core/test/campaignArc.test.ts - there is a test for 'caller passes a wrong arcId when an open arc exists' but no test for 'campaign has zero arc rows at all.' Both paths hit the same openArc === undefined branch in the implementation, but the contract should be documented for both inputs. Add a focused test.

No production risk. Pure hardening + coverage.
